Name: Lineage
Description: Gordon Nobili was part of a criminal organization that used his intellect to outsmart his rivals and enemies. When the Terrigen Mists came he transformed into a purple-skinned humanoid who gained the ability to talk to dead people in his Lineage. Lineage was created by Charles Soule and Jefte Palo and first appeared in Thunderbolts #14.
